newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK's Solartech shares 122.1 times subscribed.
newsitem.headline: HK's Solartech shares 122.1 times subscribed.

text.p: Hong Kong-based cable maker and exporter Solartech International Holdings Ltd said on Monday its public offer of shares with warrants was about 122.1 times subscribed.
Last week, the company offered 125 million shares at HK$1.20 each. Dealing of the shares is expected to start on Thursday.

Net proceeds of about HK$136 million will be used to expand existing manufacturing facilities, to acquire new machineries, to set up a joint venture, to increase the group's production capacity, to improve customer network in northern and eastern China, and to improve general working capital.
